gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the kind of measurement a diggs:TargetMeasurement plans, for use where no measurementMethod is cited or where the cited method admits several kinds of measurement. Seeded here with the load-verification and integrity-testing kinds referenced by rigid inclusion acceptance testing (ASIRI; FHWA-KS-25-02); TargetMeasurement is general DIGGS infrastructure covering every planned Test, Monitor, MaterialTest, MeasurementWhileDrilling and GeophysicalFieldSurvey, so the list is expected to grow well beyond this starting set as other domains populate it. Expect this element to be omitted in the common case, per its own documentation.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Target Measurement Kind Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A slow-maintained or constant-rate-of-penetration axial load test applying load directly to the element and measuring load-movement response, per ASTM D1143 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Static load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An axial load test applying load over roughly one to several seconds, faster than a static test and slower than a dynamic impact test, per ASTM D7383 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Rapid load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An axial load test in which the element is struck by an impact device and force and velocity are measured to estimate capacity by wave-equation analysis, per ASTM D4945 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: High-strain dynamic load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A low-strain impact (pulse-echo or transient-response) test used to detect discontinuities, necking or changes in cross-section along the length of a completed element, per ASTM D5882 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Low-strain integrity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A test applying lateral load to the element and measuring lateral load-deflection response, per ASTM D3966 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Lateral load test
